Q1: Should triage gain a cluster step?
Context:
- Today every crash report opens its own issue; nothing groups repeats (triage/intake.py:12).
- Upstream's cluster step computes a dedupe fingerprint, a SHA-1 of the report's first error line after addresses and line numbers are stripped, and attaches the report to the open cluster with the same fingerprint instead of opening an issue (vendor/upstream-triage/README.md:7-10).
- The gap: one crash seen by many users shows up as many issues (vendor/upstream-triage/README.md:16).
My recommendation: yes, add the cluster step, keyed on upstream's fingerprint.
Basis: verified, vendor/upstream-triage/README.md:7-10 and triage/intake.py:12.
Alternatives:
- (a) Keep one issue per report. No new code, but duplicates keep hiding the crash count.
- (b) Group by exact error text. Simpler than normalizing, but addresses and line numbers split one crash into many groups (vendor/upstream-triage/README.md:7).
pass.why: defines both terms, states upstream and today, alternatives carry gain and cost
